Ah, another one of your crazy tales. You no sooner arrive than you're off and running.

@@U03967@@
(Seriously.)

@@U03968@@
When the Lord God— and I know why, too— cast us from the sky to the deepest of pits (with central fire blazing eternally), we found ourselves with something too much illumination, not to mention overcrowded accommodations. We devils all began to huff and puff, fore and aft, to put out that great blaze, while roundabout was an acid stink of sulfur and a pressure of gas so monstrous it burst through earth’s flat crust, thick as it was, with a gigantic bang. Yes, well, it’s a different story now. What was once Hell’s bottom is now its top. It’s on this they base those theories required to turn things topsy-turvy. In any case, we escaped that servile place of confinement and came to gain free dominion of the air. An open secret, well preserved, revealed to the world only later.

@@U03970@@

啊，你的又一个疯狂故事。您一到达就立即出发。

@@U03967@@
（说真的。）

@@U03968@@
当主上帝——我也知道为什么——把我们从天上扔到最深的坑里（中央的火焰永远燃烧）时，我们发现自己的照明太多了，更不用说过度拥挤的住宿了。我们这些恶魔开始前后呼气，扑灭那场大火，而周围却弥漫着硫磺的酸臭味，气体的压力如此巨大，以至于在巨大的爆炸声中冲破了厚厚的地壳。是的，好吧，现在情况不同了。曾经的地狱底部如今已是地狱顶部。正是基于此，他们建立了扭转局面所需的理论。无论如何，我们逃离了那个受奴役的禁闭之地，获得了空中的自由统治权。这是一个公开的秘密，保存完好，直到后来才向世人透露。

@@U03970@@
